name: Dhatre Udyog Limited
summary: Dhatre Udyog Ltd. operates within the iron and steel industry, focusing on the manufacturing and distribution of a variety of related products. Its offerings encompass thermo-mechanically-treated (TMT) bars, in addition to a range of mild steel goods such as rounds, square bars, flat bars, angle bars, and wire rods. Kishanlal Choudhary established the firm on February 10, 1995, and it is presently headquartered in Vizianagaram, India.
